Lemons laws vary by state and the majority of these vehicles are bought back in states that have very consumer friendly warranty laws & are guaranteed to be repaired by the manufacturer before being resold.What is a Manufacturer buyback?A manufacturer buyback is a vehicle repurchased by the manufacturer from a consumer due to a complaint, often related to a recall or warranty issue. It can occur if repairs take too long due to parts being unavailable or if problems persist after repairs. The manufacturer repairs the vehicle before reselling it, and the warranty remains in place. In some cases, customers pursue this route because they may receive more money than they would by trading it in. Regarding Carfax and the title, buyback vehicles are titled under the manufacturer’s name with a notation like Branded title: Manufacturer Buyback/Lemon. Includes Level 1 Quality Plus Auto Protection (engine, transmission, drivetrain) plus our 5-Year Maintenance Plan ($2,500 value) at full out-the-door price.
Proudly serving customers with over 22,000 vehicles sold.

2017 DODGE CHARGER DAYTONA 392
485 horsepower of naturally aspirated 392 HEMI, Brembo six-piston brakes, an active exhaust that announces itself from two streets over, and four doors so everyone comes along now in matte black over Yellow Jacket. The Daytona Edition Group was a factory special edition, not a stripe kit, and Dodge doesn't build this car anymore. Read the history section before you fall in love.

?? WHAT YOU'RE ACTUALLY GETTING
? 90-point inspection and road test as standard process.
? Serviced by Duluth Auto Service & Imports, our own shop, on 09/09/2026 at 89,103 miles. Full scope of work: pre-delivery inspection completed, oil and filter change, cabin air filter replaced, fog lamp assembly replaced, one side, spark plugs replaced, primary thermostat replaced, fender liner replaced, corner light replaced, blind spot sensor replaced.
? Estimated $2,900 to $4,000 in service work already performed, valued at Atlanta-area franchise-dealer parts and labor rates rather than what our shop bills us money the next owner isn t spending. (Our estimate, a repair order documents the work, not what it would retail for.)
? Passed Georgia emissions inspection in August 2026.
? OBDII scan: all drive monitors completed, with no pending or stored trouble codes. Every readiness monitor has run and reported clean no active fault, no stored history code. The scan photo is included in this listing's photos so you can read the screen yourself rather than take our word for it.
? Sold new as a Dodge Certified Pre-Owned vehicle in 2020 after passing Chrysler's factory certification inspection.
? No structural damage, no airbag deployment, no total loss reported to CARFAX. There are accidents on this record all in the history section below but none touched the structure or set off an airbag.
? Clean title, guaranteed by CARFAX. No salvage, junk, rebuilt, fire, flood, hail, or lemon brand. No Not Actual Mileage or Exceeds Mechanical Limits brand, and no indication of an odometer rollback.
? Documented work under prior owners: oxygen sensor replaced in 2023, drive belts, tensioner, and idler pulley in late 2024.
? One key only. Not two. A replacement Charger key fob with programming typically runs $250 to $450 at a dealer or automotive locksmith. That's a real cost and you should know it now, not at delivery.

?? REAL VALUE WHAT THIS ACTUALLY COSTS YOU OVER TIME
We cross-check independent sources rather than quoting whichever one flatters us. Here's what three of them say:
CARFAX History-Based Value: $26,360
Kelley Blue Book Typical Listing Price: $29,290
DealerCenter Market Average: $29,810

We anchor to $26,360 to $29,290, and here's the honest reasoning behind it. CARFAX is the only one of the three that explicitly discounts this specific vehicle for its accident history, and that history is real. Just as important: the higher figures track what comparable Daytona 392s are advertised for, and advertised is not sold. Across the wider market, examples at similar mileage have transacted meaningfully below the asking prices you'll see listed. We'd rather anchor low and be right than anchor high and be argued with.

Now the part most shoppers never add up. Two things here are dollars you won't spend later:
5-Year Maintenance Plan $2,500 value. 25 discounted oil changes plus radiator service, AC service, and engine diagnostics, with no year or mileage cap. A 392 HEMI takes seven quarts of full synthetic and does not sip fuel the routine costs here are not trivial, and this plan spreads them across the years you own it.
Quality Plus Level 1 coverage $300 retail value, included at full out-the-door price. Engine, transmission, drivetrain. On a nine-year-old 485-horsepower car, that is the coverage that matters.

Add it up: roughly $32,050 to $36,050 in total value in this vehicle, combining cross-checked market value with the Maintenance Plan and the included coverage.

Price is only what you pay, but value is what you get. On a high-performance car nine years old, the vehicle with a documented history and finished reconditioning behind it is usually the cheaper car by year three, whatever the two window stickers say. Compare total cost of ownership across every vehicle you're considering, including ours. Market pricing moves, ask anytime and we'll pull a current market pricing report on this vehicle. Our goal is that you never overpay.

?? FEATURES & SPECS
6.4L 392 HEMI V8, 485 horsepower / 475 lb-ft
8-speed automatic (8HP70) with AutoStick paddle shifters
Rear-wheel drive, 3.09 final drive, 230mm limited-slip rear axle
Brembo six-piston front / four-piston rear brakes with vented rotors
Directed cold-air induction with Mopar conical filter
Electronically controlled active performance exhaust
Bilstein high-performance suspension
20x9.5-inch forged aluminum wheels in Low Gloss Black
180-mph primary speedometer, 220-amp alternator
Daytona hood, roof and trunk decals, grille badge, 392 fender decals
Daytona-embroidered sport bucket seats with gold accent stitching
Heated and ventilated front seats, heated steering wheel, blind spot monitoring, backup camera, Uconnect
Yellow Jacket factory paint under a matte black vinyl wrap, black interior
EPA-estimated 15 city / 25 highway MPG
Equipment above reflects the standard Daytona 392 configuration. If a specific feature matters, ask and we'll confirm it on this vehicle.

?? VEHICLE HISTORY (FULL TRANSPARENCY)
This is the section that matters most on this car. It runs long because the record does, and every line is on the CARFAX we'll hand you.

Three damage events, none structural. On 6/30/2020 a sideswipe collision was reported with damage rated minor to moderate left side, left front, and front. On 9/17/2020 a second sideswipe was reported, rated minor right side and right front. On 5/04/2021 a third event was reported, rated minor, without further detail. Airbags did not deploy in any of them. Both sides of this car have been hit. What CARFAX does not report is any structural damage, any airbag deployment, or any total loss. Minor and moderate are the two lower ratings on CARFAX's three-point scale, moderate means damage that may affect multiple components. We won't characterize repairs we didn't perform and didn't see.

Body and cosmetic work is being done right now, and you should connect it to the paragraph above. The scope at our shop includes a front bumper cover, grille, fog lamp, fender liner, rocker panel molding, and side marker and corner lights. We're replacing those parts rather than leaving them, and saying so in the same breath as the accident history rather than hoping you read the two separately.

The black is a wrap. The factory paint underneath is Yellow Jacket. This car was built in Yellow Jacket, the signature Daytona color, and Georgia title records from 2020 through 2022 note it as Yellow. It wears a matte black vinyl wrap today. A wrap sits on top of the original paint rather than replacing it, and it can be removed so if you want the yellow car, it's under there. Ask us what we know, and have your inspector look under an edge.

A thin service record for the miles. Seven service records across nine years and 89,000 miles is less documentation than we like to see. Documented: dealer service early on, the 2023 and 2024 work noted above, plus routine oil changes and alignments. The gaps are gaps. The completed-monitor scan above is a useful counterweight, but it speaks to today, not to the years nobody wrote down.

It has moved around. Offered in New York, auctioned, certified and sold in South Carolina, registered in Georgia, auctioned again in 2023, retitled in North Carolina, serviced in California, and offered by a Jacksonville dealer six weeks before we acquired it. Frequent movement isn't a defect, but no owner's care shows up as one unbroken thread.

Realistic expectations. This is a nine-year-old, 485-horsepower rear-drive car with 89,000 miles that has been hit three times and repaired by people we've never met. It is also one of the best-sounding sedans ever mass-produced, and Dodge isn't making another. Both are true. Tires, brakes, and fuel on a 392 cost what they cost. Buy it with your eyes open and it's a car you'll be glad you bought.

?? BUYER'S GUIDE & REALISTIC EXPECTATIONS
Federal law requires every dealer to post a Buyers Guide on each used vehicle, and you'll sign one here. It's worth reading, because it lists the major systems that can fail on a used vehicle engine, transmission, differential, cooling, electrical, fuel, brakes, steering, suspension, air conditioning and it exists precisely because used vehicles are used. That list isn't a warning about this Charger, it's the baseline for any vehicle of this age and mileage. We'd rather set a real expectation now than make a promise nobody can honestly make.

?? PRE-PURCHASE INSPECTION WE'RE ASKING YOU TO GET ONE
We're happy to accommodate a pre-purchase inspection at a Carma-verified shop, on-site or within a 10-mile radius, prior to finalizing your purchase and once terms are agreed upon. Ask your sales consultant for details.

?? READY WHEN YOU ARE
Call or text (470) 492-0034

Financing available for a wide range of credit profiles ask us what you qualify for before you fall in love with a payment.
?? Not local? We've shipped thousands of vehicles across the US and can ship direct to you at discounted rates ask for a quote.

??? QUALITY PLUS COVERAGE & CERTIFICATION
This vehicle qualifies as one of our Dealer Certified Pre-Owned units, meaning it has passed our multi-point inspection and meets our age, condition, and mileage criteria. When purchased at our full out-the-door price, this vehicle includes Level 1 coverage under our Quality Plus Auto Protection Plan (engine, transmission, and drivetrain) at no additional cost, plus our 5-Year Maintenance Plan 25 discounted oil changes, radiator service, AC service, engine diagnostics, and hundreds of additional discounts, with no year or mileage restrictions ($2,500 value). Coverage is honored nationwide at ASE-certified repair facilities that work with our warranty provider, so you can drive with confidence wherever the road takes you. If a price reduction or discount is applied to this vehicle, this included coverage is replaced with the option to purchase our Quality Plus Auto Protection Plan (3 months / 3,000 miles) and 5-Year Maintenance Plan at a discounted rate, available at time of sale. Customers also have the option to upgrade to additional warranty coverage, including a Lifetime Warranty upgrade, at a discounted rate available only at the time of sale. Warranty upgrade eligibility varies by vehicle age, mileage, condition, and other factors, not all vehicles qualify. Ask your sales consultant to confirm eligibility for this specific vehicle.

? Estimated value of that work: roughly $1,698 to $1,727. This is an estimate at dealer-equivalent rates for the front and rear brake pads, front rotors, spark plugs, engine air filter, and oil change, since CARFAX does not report actual costs. The tires, lug studs, cabin air filter, and inspection are not counted, so the real value of the work is higher.
? Earlier documented work includes front and rear wheel bearings and hubs and four tires (06/2024), and brake pads with four new tires (11/2019)
? We scan nearly every vehicle we sell and include the results in our photos. If you don't see a current OBDII scan for this one, just ask and we'll run a fresh scan and send it to you before you ever come in.

?? Real Value
We cross-check every number instead of quoting the one that looks best. Here is where this vehicle's market value stands today:
? CARFAX History-Based Retail Value: $19,320
? J.D. Power retail book: $20,450
? Manheim adjusted retail average: $20,600
? Kelley Blue Book typical listing price: $21,940
? Live market average for comparable 2017 IS 200t models: $21,957
These sources spread by about $2,600, so we are showing you the whole range, $19,320 to $21,957, instead of picking a favorite. CARFAX's figure factors in the reported accident history, while the market-based figures are built from comparable vehicles that may not share it. For context, ten comparable 2017 IS 200t models within 200 miles, with 65,314 to 94,093 miles, are listed at $19,763 to $25,189, and the ones closest to this mileage (79,539 to 86,602 miles) are listed at $21,590 to $22,664. Four of the ten are currently active in our market data and the rest are recent listings, so these are listing prices, not confirmed sale prices.

Now add what comes with this car:
? Documented service by our own team, estimated: $1,698 to $1,727

? Quality Plus Auto Protection Plan: $300 retail value

Those added dollars are future money, not decoration. The brakes and spark plugs are already bought and paid for. The 5-Year Maintenance Plan means 25 oil changes plus radiator service, AC service, and engine diagnostics at a discount, with no year or mileage cap, spread across the years you actually own the car. The Quality Plus coverage means an engine or transmission failure is not a rebuild bill: it covers up to $1,500 in repair costs. Those are real dollars you will not spend in the months and years ahead, and they belong in the comparison when you are weighing this Lexus against a cheaper one somewhere else.

Price is only what you pay, but value is what you get. A vehicle that costs less today can cost far more over three years of ownership once deferred service and an unprotected powertrain catch up with it. Buying a vehicle is a major financial decision, so we encourage you to compare total value, not just sticker price.

Market pricing can change. Our goal is that you never overpay and that you receive as much value as possible, so we're always happy to provide a more current market pricing report on request.

Ask your sales consultant for the full equipment list and to confirm options on this specific vehicle.

On 03/05/2025 it reported an accident in which the vehicle was in a rear-end collision with another motor vehicle, with damage to the front and no airbag deployment. On 11/14/2025 it reported minor damage in an incident with another motor vehicle, with damage to the left front, left side, and left rear and no airbag deployment. CARFAX describes minor damage as generally cosmetic and typically not affecting a vehicle's operation or safety. The same report shows no total loss, no structural damage, no airbag deployment, and no title brands, and it recommends a collision repair specialist inspection on any vehicle with reported accidents.
? Repair details: CARFAX does not report what repairs were done after these events, so we encourage you to look the body over carefully in person and to take us up on the inspection offer below, including at a collision repair facility if you like.

A repossession is a lender action, and CARFAX shows no damage and no title brand tied to it. It was sold at auction again on 08/24/2026 before coming to us.

? Keys: this vehicle comes with one key.

? Age and wear: this is a nine-year-old vehicle with 83,723 miles. Expect the normal wear that comes with age and use, and ask us for any cosmetic details you want to see in person.

?? Buyer's Guide & Realistic Expectations
Every vehicle we sell carries the federal Buyers Guide, and almost nobody reads it. It lists the systems where used vehicles most commonly develop problems, among them the engine, transmission, differential, cooling, electrical, steering, brakes, suspension, exhaust, fuel, and air conditioning systems. Any used vehicle, including a well-serviced one like this, can need work in any of them over time, and we would rather you know that now than be surprised later. It is a big part of why we include coverage and a maintenance plan with this car.

We're happy to accommodate a pre-purchase inspection at a Carma-verified shop, on-site or within a 10-mile radius, prior to finalizing your purchase and once terms are agreed upon. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. description: This 2020 Lexus IS 300 F-Sport is exactly the kind of Lexus we love finding at Supreme Motors. Finished in the coveted white over red color combination, this one has a perfectly clean Carfax with no accidents or blemishes at all and comes equipped with the must-have F-Sport Package, F-Sport wheel package, LFA-inspired TFT instrumentation, adaptive cruise control, Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert, Intuitive Park Assist, heated steering wheel, heated seats, moonroof, backup camera, and more. White over red is one of our favorite Lexus combinations by far because every time you open the door, the interior immediately feels special.The F-Sport Package completely transforms the IS 300. You get the much more aggressive F-Sport front bumper, updated spindle grille, upgraded side skirts, sculpted rear bumper and rear diffuser, upgraded F-Sport wheels, sport-tuned suspension, upgraded steering components, F-Sport steering wheel, aluminum sport pedals, F-Sport badging throughout, and a much more performance-oriented interior. It is not simply an appearance package. The entire car looks, feels, and drives substantially more athletic than a standard IS.The front end is one of the biggest differences. The F-Sport grille and bumper give the car a dramatically sharper and more aggressive face, while the upgraded side skirts visually lower the car and carry that styling into the rear bumper and diffuser. The F-Sport badges on the front fenders and rear trunk lid finish the look and immediately let people know this is not the ordinary version.Then there are the F-Sport wheels, which absolutely set the car off. They fill the wheel wells properly and give the IS a more aggressive stance, especially against the white exterior. Pair them with the F-Sport bodywork and red interior and this is exactly how we want an IS 300 built.Inside, the red F-Sport interior is next level. The white exterior keeps the outside clean and timeless, then you open the door and the red interior completely changes the personality of the car. Add the F-Sport steering wheel, aluminum pedals, sport details, and darker interior accents and the whole cockpit feels much more special than a standard IS.One of the most important F-Sport upgrades is the LFA-inspired TFT instrument panel. Instead of the old-school analog-style gauge cluster found in non-F-Sport models, you get a much more advanced digital performance display inspired by the legendary Lexus LFA.This is one of those options that changes the entire age of the interior. The conventional analog setup can make the car feel like something from the mid-2000s, while the LFA-inspired digital cluster feels like something out of a 2027-model-year Lexus. It is directly in front of you every second you drive, so the difference is massive.The F-Sport steering wheel is another major upgrade. It has a sportier shape, better grip, and a much more performance-focused feel in your hands. Combined with the upgraded suspension and steering components, the whole car feels more connected and more responsive from behind the wheel.You also get the aluminum sport pedals, another small detail that makes a surprisingly big difference in the cabin. They continue the performance theme and help separate the F-Sport interior from the more traditional luxury setup found in basic IS models.The upgraded twin-projector LED headlights with LED high and low beams give the front end a much sharper nighttime appearance and provide excellent visibility after dark. They work perfectly with the aggressive F-Sport grille and bumper design.Then there is the adaptive cruise control, one of the best everyday features you can have. Traditional cruise control simply locks you at one speed. Lexus Dynamic Radar Cruise Control can monitor the vehicle ahead and automatically adjust your speed to help maintain a selected following distance.When freeway traffic slows, the Lexus can slow with it. When traffic opens up, it can accelerate back toward your selected cruising speed. It takes away a huge amount of the constant throttle adjustment required on longer highway drives and makes commuting dramatically easier. Once you get accustomed to a good adaptive cruise system, it is hard to want another car without it.This one also has Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert, giving you an extra set of eyes in situations where visibility can be difficult. Blind Spot Monitor helps watch the areas alongside the vehicle during lane changes, while Rear Cross-Traffic Alert helps warn you about approaching traffic when backing out of a crowded parking space.The Intuitive Park Assist is another excellent everyday feature. Combined with the backup camera, it makes garages, tight parking spaces, and crowded lots much easier to navigate and helps protect those F-Sport wheels and bumpers.The heated steering wheel and heated front seats are must-have options in colder weather. The steering wheel starts warming your hands almost immediately, while the seat heat gets you comfortable much faster than waiting for the entire cabin to warm up.The power moonroof adds natural light to the cabin and makes the red interior feel even brighter and more open. It is one of those simple features that makes everyday driving more enjoyable.You also get Bluetooth connectivity, push-button start, premium climate control, power seating, satellite radio, backup camera, and all the everyday equipment you want in a properly equipped Lexus.Most people spend a huge part of their life in their vehicle. You drive it to work, take it on trips, pick up friends and family, run errands, and live thousands of little moments inside it. So there is real value in choosing something that still makes you feel good every time you see it. Walking out to a white IS 300 F-Sport, opening the door to that incredible red interior, and genuinely looking forward to the drive is worth something. You work hard. The vehicle you live with every day should feel special.And sometimes, a great car becomes more than transportation. We once had someone approach us at a gas station because of a vehicle. That quick conversation turned into discovering mutual friends, then into a real friendship, and years later that person was standing beside us in our wedding party. It started with two people appreciating the same car. That is the part people forget: vehicles can create conversations, memories, connections, and experiences that last far longer than the ownership itself.Most importantly, this one has the history we want to see: a perfectly clean Carfax with no accidents or blemishes, excellent overall condition, and the right combination of options and colors.Combine the white-over-red color combination, F-Sport Package, aggressive F-Sport bodywork, F-Sport wheels, sport suspension, upgraded steering, LFA-inspired TFT digital cluster, adaptive cruise control, Blind Spot Monitor, Rear Cross-Traffic Alert, Intuitive Park Assist, heated steering wheel, heated seats, twin-projector LED headlights, moonroof, and clean Carfax, and you have one seriously sharp 2020 Lexus IS 300 F-Sport.The white-over-red combination, F-Sport styling, LFA-inspired digital cockpit, adaptive cruise, and perfectly clean history make this exactly the kind of IS 300 F-Sport buyers wait for.
